ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 40% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white pixels (distal lobes) and 60% consists of low-intensity black pixels (medial and central areas).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral third of both lobes. The central region is a solid low-intensity black field, with high-contrast mottled transition zones and dark linear streaks within the white distal fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe centers; depth is approximately 12% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 4 and 18 pixels, with prominent jagged spikes on the medial edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the leading and outer edges, sweeping upward and tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white distal pigmentation; orientation is primarily diagonal from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) across both lobes and significant barnacle encrustation at the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp, nearly vertical boundary on the right lobe between the dark central pigment and the white distal tip; presence of small, low-contrast circular marks in the dark central region.
